eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Gaines, TX; at 2:38 PM on SEP 15, 2026 Effective until 5:38 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Grass Fire Alert: Lightning-caused grass fires are burning near FM 1788 & CR 422 and FM 181 & CR 315. Low visibility and fast-moving fire conditions are present. Fire crews are actively working both scenes. Please avoid these areas.
